card.name: Start of drug and hormone-tumor names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer drug or hormone term, such as Sum in Sumatriptan, Pent in Pentazocine, or insulin and glucagon before -oma. Also the word hormone before replacement.

modes.label: Drug name openings
modes.description: The first piece of a brand or generic drug name split into parts, right after a verb like discontinue or titrate.

modes.label: Hormone-producing tumors
modes.description: Insulin or glucagon at the point where -oma is about to follow.

modes.label: Hormone before replacement
modes.description: The word hormone just before replacement therapy.

card.plain: It lights up partway through drug names like Sumatriptan or insulinoma, and on hormone before replacement.
